differences.what: A module, exam_msk, that the General note type includes. Its two sections, Musculoskeletal and Gait, show only while MSK (exam.systems is msk) is picked in the exam picker, and each offers one-tap Normal.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory default 10

differences.what: Musculoskeletal repeats, one entry for each region examined, up to 10, each titled Region {n}: the parts B to F and H are asked in each entry. Gait (part G) is asked once for the exam, in the second section, Gait: a person walks once, whatever regions were examined.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 16; forms 6.3; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the most regions in one exam (the nine regions and one more, so the full General stays well under its limit of answers)

differences.what: The guidance line is not typed.
Where are you examining? is choose-one: each entry is one region, and another region is another entry. Normal picks none. Other asks for a short text.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 16, 29, 31; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): Normal does nothing in an entry until its region is picked (default 29 asks)

differences.what: Side (Oct 19) follows the region, choose-one from the shared list side: Right, Left, Bilateral (added). It shows for every region but Head / Neck and Back.
Once a region is selected: every part after the region shows only once the entry's region is picked.
Inspection is choose-many. Normal is the normal option and clears the others.
Palpation is choose-many; No tenderness is the normal option and clears the others. Pain, a whole number from 0 to 10 out of 10, shows only while Tenderness is picked. Normal leaves Pain empty.

Range of motion is two fields, Active and Passive, each choose-many from the shared list range_of_motion: Full is its normal option and clears the others, and so does Unable; Limited and Painful can be held together.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory section 5 (range of motion), default 13, 16, 26

differences.what: Strength is a whole number from 0 to 5 out of 5, recorded for the right and the left (sides: the bullets Right and Left are the sides, not options). Normal fills 5.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 28, 44; forms 2.2 (normal on a number)

differences.what: Scale: 0–5 is the range of Strength.
Tone (Oct 19) is choose-one: Hypertonic, Hypotonic, Isotonic (added), one value for the region, not one for each side. Normal leaves it empty: the inventories give no normal tone.
differences.why: PRD main 103; focused-exam inventory default 3; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): is Isotonic the tone Normal fills?

differences.what: Sensation is choose-many. Intact is the normal option and clears the others.
Pulses is choose-one: Intact (the normal option), Decreased, Absent. It stays a quick check in words, not the pulse scale.
Capillary refill is choose-one from the shared list capillary_refill, whose normal option is Less than 2 seconds.

Gait is the second section's one field, asked once for the exam, choose-many. Normal is the normal option and clears the others. Unable to assess is neither normal nor abnormal, and clears the others.

Region-Specific Tests is one grid in the entry, Shoulder tests, shown only while the entry's region is Shoulder, with a row for each of the five tests and each cell choose-one from the shared list special_test_result: Not performed, Negative, Positive, Unable. Normal fills Not performed. The code neer is given for Neer's: the rule makes neer_s.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory 3.6, default 26, 36; forms 5 (shoulder only); recipe step 5

differences.what: The guidance line and the example heading are not typed.
No tests are typed for other regions: they wait for the clinical team's lists, and come as a new version.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 10.2 #1; focused-exam inventory default 36, 54
